criteria.criterion: Payslip content is recognizable; filename insufficient
Employee identity matches the case borrower
Salary month and year printed within document must be legible
Both gross and net available and valid numbers; amounts do not define credit eligibility
Gross minus stated deductions equals net within formatting normalization, unless pay components demand additional evidence
Each extracted amount and period has actual source PDF page and verified excerpt; coordinates optional if unavailable

verdict_policy: VALID if all required document-level checks pass; INVALID if clearly wrong borrower/type or confirmed failure; NEEDS_REVIEW if uncertain; never certify authenticity.
